title: THE COGNITION ANNALS
lede: An unauthorized, over-decorated, fully static record of Cognition — the lab that went from three IOI gold medalists in a San Francisco living room to the company behind Devin, Windsurf, and the SWE model line. Every page on this node was compiled by dogbed: knap template in, markdown through the middle, HTML out. No CMS. No JavaScript. No edit button.

>> the lab, the agent, the models — an exhibit in fifteen transmissions <<

## WHAT IS THIS NODE This is a museum built out of plain text. Somewhere upstream there is a file called page.knap, a pile of JSON objects, and a single Zig binary named dogbed. The binary chewed the templates, spat out Markdown, pushed it through oliver, and soldered the result into the document you are reading. The entire site — the scanlines, the ticker, the bezel — is one stylesheet and zero lines of JavaScript. The subject matter deserves the treatment. In under three years, Cognition went from unveiling a demo of “the first AI software engineer” to training reinforcement-learning models at multi-trillion-parameter scale, rescuing an orphaned IDE in a weekend, and shipping a coding model that sits within a point of the frontier at a fraction of the cost. These are the annals of that run. ## ARCHIVE CLOSED The operator reported on November 5, 2026 that the Devin trial appeared to have ended. ChatGPT Sol completed the final close-out, including a separate inventory of verified GitHub merges and downloadable receipts that survive uninstalling Devin. The older usage and commit figures remain the November 3 snapshots; the disk-usage exhibit is dated November 4. ## THE DIRECTORY

## SUGGESTED READING ORDER 1. Start at the company for the founding myth and the money. 2. Walk the model line in order: SWE-1 → SWE-1.5 → SWE-1.6 → SWE-1.7 → SWE-2. 3. Detour into the Windsurf gambit for the most dramatic weekend in AI coding history. 4. Finish in the products museum, where the smaller machines live. 5. Then open the operator’s own books: the burn ledger and the commit log. 6. Close the archive in the epilogue. > Within our lifetime, engineers will go from bricklayers to architects, focusing on the creativity of designing systems — and delegating the construction to agents. — Scott Wu, CEO

All figures are as publicly reported by Cognition, press coverage, and product docs at the time of archival (October 2026). Benchmarks are vendor-reported unless noted. This node is an exhibit, not an offer to sell securities.
